name: Exterior Engineered Wood Siding Repaint
description: Combined condition assessment + prep + prime + finish repaint specification for previously painted exterior engineered wood siding (LP SmartSide lap and panel profiles). Covers multi-point condition assessment, low-pressure power wash (500-1000 PSI — EW-specific allowance), condition-driven prep, state-driven primer selection, finish coat application (spray_backroll primary, brush_roll fallback), interstage protocol, final inspection, and EPA RRP lead-safe containment for pre-1978 structures.

in_scope: Engineered wood siding field surface repaint (LP SmartSide lap and panel profiles)
Multi-point condition assessment (visual, adhesion, chalk, moisture, edge seal, caulk)
Low-pressure power wash (500-1000 PSI) — EW-specific departure from FC RP (rinse only) and NC (garden hose only)
Condition-driven surface preparation (scrape/feather, degloss/scuff, chalk remediation, mildew treatment)
Caulk assessment and replacement at siding-to-trim joints (butt joints assessed, removed if failed, NOT re-caulked)
Edge seal integrity assessment (replaces NC edge seal application)
State-driven primer application (chalk-binding, acrylic stain-block, bonding for exposed ExpertFinish)
Finish coat application — spray_backroll primary (2-person crew), brush_roll fallback
Interstage inspection, QT4 intercoat sand, touch-up
out_of_scope: Siding replacement or structural repair (refer to siding contractor)
T1-11 profile repaint (rare RP scenario — T&M consideration)
Structural moisture remediation (stop work if MC >15%)

configuration_dimensions.description: QT2 economy (1 finish coat), QT3 standard (2 finish coats per LP warranty), QT4 premium (2 finish coats + interstage sand). QT5 excluded per Exterior_Substrates_Doctrine §5.4.
spray_backroll is PRIMARY RP method for all profiles (departure from NC spray-only on smooth). brush_roll is fallback for <750 SF, occupied-adjacent, or high wind. spray-only is NOT valid for RP.
Exterior siding sheens. Flat is standard for siding field. Satin for accent or customer preference.
4 exterior RP substrate states. Per-elevation assignment. Drives primer selection and prep intensity.
Overall coating condition drives prep modifier. GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x on prep tasks.
LP SmartSide profiles. Lap=1.00x baseline, panel=0.90x (faster in RP). NO T1-11 in RP. NO shingle (EW doesn't come in shingle).
2 textures. Smooth=1.00x, textured=1.15x. 'Textured' combines NC cedarmill/roughsawn — existing paint film moderates original texture.
Per-elevation access. Drives FAC_EXT_ACCESS height modifier.
Pre-1978 building flag. Gates MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT and FAC_EWRP_RRP (2.0x prep modifier).

variants.name: Spray/Backroll — Good Condition (No Prime)
variants.notes: Sound paint, verified adhesion. Degloss/scuff + direct to finish. No prime needed.

variants.name: Spray/Backroll — Fair/Chalking (Chalk-Binding Prime)
variants.notes: Chalk-binding primer mandatory on full surface. Power wash + chalk remediation + chalk-binding primer + finish.

variants.name: Spray/Backroll — Fair/Failing Paint (Acrylic Stain-Block Prime)
variants.notes: Localized failing paint. Scrape/feather + spot or full acrylic stain-block primer + finish.

variants.name: Spray/Backroll — Poor/Peeling (Full Acrylic Stain-Block Prime)
variants.notes: Extensive peeling. Heavy scrape/feather + full acrylic stain-block primer + finish. Bonding primer if ExpertFinish substrate exposed.

variants.name: Brush/Roll — Good Condition (No Prime)
variants.notes: Brush/roll fallback. Sound paint, no prime.

input_states.description: Existing paint is well-adhered, minimal chalk, passes adhesion test. Degloss/scuff only — skip prime.
Surface chalking present. Chalk-binding primer mandatory. May be combined with sound underlying paint.
Cracking, alligatoring, flaking in localized areas. Scrape/feather + spot or full prime.
Active coating lifting from substrate. Heavy scrape + full prime. May expose ExpertFinish requiring bonding primer.

material_systems_summary.description: Acrylic stain-block primer for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT and SS_EXT_PEELING. NOT alkali-resistant — EW is neutral pH.
Chalk-binding primer for SS_EXT_CHALKING. Full surface application.
Bonding primer for exposed ExpertFinish factory-finished substrate. Reused from NC.
100% acrylic exterior latex finish. QT2/QT3. LP SmartSide-approved. Reused from NC.
Premium 100% acrylic exterior latex finish. QT4. LP SmartSide-approved. Reused from NC.

compatibility_rules.description: SS_EXT_CHALKING requires chalk-binding primer (SYS_EXT_EWRP_PRIMER_CHALK_BIND). Standard acrylic primer NOT acceptable.
SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT with verified adhesion = skip prime module entirely. Degloss/scuff → direct to finish.
NO alkali-resistant primer on engineered wood. EW is neutral pH. This is a KEY departure from FC RP.
Butt joint caulk: REMOVE failed caulk but do NOT re-caulk. Butt joint caulk creates moisture trap against OSB core.
Power wash NEVER exceed 1000 PSI on engineered wood. >1000 PSI forces water into OSB core at joints/cut edges.
spray-only is NOT valid for RP. All coating tasks require spray_backroll or brush_roll.
Exposed ExpertFinish substrate (from scraping) requires bonding primer (SYS_EXT_EW_PRIMER_BONDING), not standard acrylic.
QT2 single coat is outside LP SmartSide warranty coverage. Customer acknowledgment recommended.

cross_spec_notes.nc_sibling: SF_SIDING_ENGINEERED_EXT_NC_v1 — 29 tasks, ENSD prefix. NC provides baseline rates for DIRECT/MODIFIED transfers.
cross_spec_notes.fc_rp_sibling: SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_RP_v1 — 45 tasks, FCRP prefix. FC RP provides pattern for RP_NEW tasks.
key_departures_from_nc: spray_backroll replaces spray as primary (all profiles)
Power wash 500-1000 PSI allowed (NC: garden hose only)
4 RP substrate states replace 4 NC substrate states
Assessment module: 6 RP_NEW tasks for condition evaluation
Condition scale: GOOD/FAIR/POOR drives prep intensity
key_departures_from_fc_rp: Power wash OK at 500-1000 PSI (FC RP: garden hose rinse only)
NO alkali-resistant primer (EW neutral pH vs FC pH 13.0)
NO efflorescence treatment (EW is not cementitious)
Butt joint caulk removed but NOT replaced (FC may re-caulk)
cross_spec_notes.deduplication: RRP containment (MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT) is shared — do NOT duplicate when running alongside other exterior RP specs on same elevation.
